changes.title: Clock party spell
items: The game clock starts when she casts the party spell; until then a prompt under it says which key casts it

changes.title: Speaker stones
items: The home speakers start as small runestones round the dancefloor, and the boot turns each one into its speaker: it glows, stretches and springs up with a flash

changes.title: Heron legs
items: The heron stands on slender stilts with splayed toes at every age, and its legend sleeps with its neck folded down onto its back
